$schema: Per-path prompts for the sitewide collapsed-button feedback pattern (S128/S129). Used by assets/micro-feedback.js — pages without an explicit entry fall back to default.

default.prompt: How can we make this page better?

/.prompt: Did this page convince you to dig deeper?

/membership/.prompt: Is the Vault Member offer clear and worth it?

/studio-pulse/.prompt: Does the studio pulse feel honest and useful?

ownership: S128: collapsed bottom-right button is now the canonical default (was per-page card before).
S129: prompts moved out of the JS into this data file so future copy changes don't require asset rebuild.
